hints.title: Resource Hierarchy or Capacity Restriction
hints.text: Five philosophers seated around a circular table share adjacent forks. If all five pick up their left fork simultaneously, a circular deadlock occurs. What resource constraint prevents deadlocks?

hints.title: Limiting Concurrency to 4 Eaters
hints.text: Allowing at most four philosophers to attempt eating at any moment guarantees by the pigeonhole principle that at least one philosopher can claim both forks and finish eating.

hints.title: Semaphore Guard and Fork Locks
hints.text: Acquire an eater semaphore initialized to 4. Then acquire both adjacent fork locks, perform eating actions, release the fork locks, and release the eater semaphore.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import threading

class DiningPhilosophers:
    def __init__(self):
        self.forks = [threading.Lock() for _ in range(5)]
        self.limit = threading.Semaphore(4)

    def wantsToEat(self,
                   philosopher: int,
                   pickLeftFork: 'Callable[[], None]',
                   pickRightFork: 'Callable[[], None]',
                   eat: 'Callable[[], None]',
                   putLeftFork: 'Callable[[], None]',
                   putRightFork: 'Callable[[], None]') -> None:
        left = philosopher
        right = (philosopher + 1) % 5

        with self.limit:
            with self.forks[left]:
                with self.forks[right]:
                    pickLeftFork()
                    pickRightFork()
                    eat()
                    putLeftFork()
                    putRightFork()
```

complexity.notes: Each meal involves acquiring bounded synchronization locks in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Symmetric lock acquisition without limiting eaters creates a circular wait condition leading to deadlock.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary storage for 5 fork locks and 1 counting semaphore.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formal explanation of how the 4-eater limit or asymmetric fork ordering breaks Coffman deadlock conditions.
